<title level="1" right="Focus 5" pfs="Standard">
[Elemental Blast](/Spells.aspx?ID=503)
<actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Focus" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=511" />
<trait label="Sorcerer" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=148" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 404 <sup>4.0</sup>

**Bloodline**
[Elemental](/Bloodlines.aspx?ID=6)

<row gap="medium">

**Cast** [somatic](/Rules.aspx?ID=283), [verbal](/Rules.aspx?ID=284)

 

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Range** 30 feet (burst only)

**Area** 10-foot-radius burst, 30-foot cone, or 60-foot line

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Saving Throw** 
[basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex

</row>

</column>

---

You gather elemental energy and blast your foes in one of the various listed shapes of your choosing, dealing 8d6 bludgeoning damage (or fire damage if your element is fire). This spell has your element's trait.

---
**Heightened (+1)** The damage increases by 2d6.
name: Elemental Blast
